human_tolerance.notes: Wikipedia: favours forested or scrubby areas with plentiful undergrowth, from which it rarely ventures, though can be found close to urban areas. Classification is a judgement.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Wikipedia: breeding season is June or July to November or December. Start and end dates are the nearest MM-DD window to that statement, not a measured curve.

vocalizations.description: Loud, high-pitched call given as ts-cheer or ch-weip, ch-weip, ch-weip, per Wikipedia. Used as the song and contact call; cooldown is a judgement.
Alarm note given when a threat approaches; sound not described in the sources checked, so this entry is an authored placeholder for the behaviour program's alarm action.

range.note: Country-level AU derived from Wikipedia distribution text (coastal eastern Australia, NSW-Queensland border to Adelaide). Subspecies and Tasmania excluded as described there.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Passerine hopping and short flight are inferred from perching songbird form; no source describes the gait explicitly.

traits.mass_kg.note: AVONET mean adult Mass 13.23 g for Sericornis frontalis (BirdLife taxonomy, which spans a wider range than the Wikipedia taxonomy), converted to kg.

traits.length_m.note: Wikipedia: mainland birds measure 11.5 cm in length.

traits.diet.note: Wikipedia: predominantly insectivorous, some seeds and fruit; AVONET trophic niche Invertivore. The 0.9/0.05/0.05 split is an authored estimate, not a measured proportion.

traits.social.note: Wikipedia: small groups of up to six birds; cooperative breeding.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Diurnal inferred from the species' daytime singing and foraging described in Wikipedia; no nocturnal records noted.

habitat.note: Use, resource and shelter weights are authored from Wikipedia habitat and behaviour text (undergrowth, ground feeding in litter, nests on or near ground in dense cover).

seasonal.note: Sedentary per Wikipedia; breeding window is the nearest MM-DD translation of June-July to November-December.

behavior.note: bt-perching-songbird-v1. Nest months are limited to two months by the program's month_in parameter, so breeding-season nest-building cannot be expressed in full. Flee distance is judgement.

vocalizations.note: The song description is from Wikipedia. The alarm entry has no source and is authored.

look.note: Look block is judgement from Wikipedia's plumage text (olive brown upperparts, pale underparts, white brow, dark bill).

traits.flight.note: Class-level trait for a passerine bird (Wikipedia describes the species as a bird; feathers, endothermy, lungs, powered flight, no metamorphosis, cup/ground nest and perching are the Passeriformes norm). Not stated line-by-line in the source.
